title: The Old Normal is Back!
seoTitle: The Old Normal is Back! – Life as Sakti
description: Oh, Forgetful Creature of this universe, Oh inconsistent one!New Normal came and went, Old normal held the reign!Realization of illusion in materialism, Beauty of natureThe taste of home cooked food, good habits went in vain!False promises of human values, the myth of self-explorationinfidelity with nature, We all back in the old game!Sakti Bagchi It's not…
html: It’s not long when we all encountered lockdown, pandemic, and the greatest threat to the human race for the first time. We all were scared and thought twice before going out, changed our food habits, and questioned our need for materialistic pleasures. The world cried collectively ‘A New Normal.’ But today, when you step out, you can see the craving for the old normal is so much it feels we are celebrating the miscarriage of beautiful thoughts that developed over the past 9 months
